title: Smoky Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African stew made with lamb, aromatic spices, and dried fruits. Serve with couscous or crusty bread.

ingredients.name: Moroccan spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most spice stores or online

instructions: Heat the oil in the tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the spice blend, apricots, prunes, and honey.
Stir to combine, then add 1 cup (240ml) of water.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2-3 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
